## Result
Shipped BAD-035's two sortable date columns on admin /scenes. Three files, the planned deliverables and nothing else (git status --porcelain: ' M admin/src/app/scenes/page.tsx', ' M admin/src/lib/scenes.ts', '?? test/server/admin-scenes-list.test.mjs').

COLUMN SEMANTICS. Both are WITHIN-WINDOW max timestamps, null when that side has no rows. lastImportedAt = max(created_at) over the existing 'acquired' CTE (scene_imports plus scene_saves kind='create'), added as last_imported_at in 'acq'. lastRecordedAt = max(created_at) over the existing 'recorded' CTE (recorded_takes joined to scene_recordings), added as last_recorded_at in 'rec'. Both source CTEs already filter created_at >= now() - ($1 * interval '1 day') before anything aggregates, so narrowing the window MOVES these dates rather than revealing older ones. In 'scenes' they are selected straight off the full outer join as a.last_imported_at / r.last_recorded_at with NO coalesce: a date has no zero, and borrowing the other half's timestamp would claim an acquisition the window does not contain. Null therefore means exactly what the dash beside it means -- no rows on that side inside the window (installed before the window and only performed inside it; or installed inside it and never performed). SORTS gained last_imported -> last_imported_at and last_recorded -> last_recorded_at; the existing order clause already appends 'nulls last', so nulls sink in both directions. SceneRow gained lastImportedAt/lastRecordedAt: string | null, mapped in listScenes through the existing iso() guard. The count query and sceneDetail are untouched (countScenes shares the CTEs and only counts rows; sceneDetail builds its own a/r). Still ONE round trip -- no second query, nothing concurrent, so admin-pool.test.mjs stays satisfied. Header prose gained a 'the timestamps' section and both SceneRow fields carry doc comments.

PAGE. Two Th headers, k="last_imported" (Last imported) and k="last_recorded" (Last recorded); cells render <TimeAgo iso={...} label={relative(...)} /> (relative age visible, exact local + UTC moment in the title, as the detail page's Last take does) and <span className="cell-sub">--</span> when null; empty-row colSpan 4 -> 6. Still a server component, no client hooks; TimeAgo is imported, not declared.

DEVIATION FROM THE BRIEF, DELIBERATE AND FLAGGED. The brief said 'two new Th headers after "Users recorded"'. I placed them after 'Sessions', i.e. at the end of the row. Taken literally the brief's order gives Scene | Imported | Users recorded | Last imported | Last recorded | Sessions, which splits the Imported/Users recorded/Sessions triple the detail page's three stat cards also use, and pairs neither date with its own count. Dates-last also matches the drill-down, whose Last take is its final column. Moving them is a two-line move of the Th pair and the td pair if Spud prefers the literal order; nothing else depends on the position (colSpan counts headers, the test asserts 6 headers == colSpan rather than an index).
